question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given idiom.

At the __last__ hour
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"last hour"** means the final moments or the very end of a period of time. (अंतिम समय)

 
 
• **Example:** He submitted his assignment at the** last hour.**
 
 
 
• **"Eleventh hour"** refers to the latest possible time before it is too late. (ग्यारहवां घंटा)
 
 
• **Example:** They reached an agreement at the** eleventh hour.**
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the phrase** "at the last hour" **can be correctly substituted with **"eleventh hour".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Half** (आधा): One of two equal or nearly equal parts.

 
 
• **Example:** He ate half of the pizza.
 
 
 
• **Sixth** (छठा): The position that comes after the fifth.
 
 
• **Example:** She finished in sixth place in the race.
 
 
 
• **Twelfth** (बारहवां): The position that comes after the eleventh.
 
 
• **Example:** He was born on the twelfth of December.
